# Window Film Salt Lake City

> Professional window film and window tinting installation for homes and businesses across Salt Lake City and the Wasatch Front. Locally owned and operated since 2008. Over 2,400 projects completed, 1.2 million+ square feet of film installed, 4.9-star rating.

Window Film Salt Lake City is a Scottish Window Tinting company providing residential, commercial, government, and specialty window film installation across Salt Lake City, the Park City, Salt Lake Valley, Utah County, Davis County, Salt Lake County, and Summit County. Clean markdown versions of key pages are available with a `.md` extension.

## Services
- [Residential Window Film](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/services/residential-window-film): home tinting, UV protection, privacy, safety, and decorative film
- [Commercial Window Film](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/services/commercial-window-film): solar control, anti-graffiti, safety and security, decorative and branding
- [Safety & Security Film](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/services/safety-security-film): holds shattered glass together, meets safety standards
- [Decorative Film](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/services/decorative-film): frosted, etched, and custom-branded glass
- [Anti-Graffiti Film](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/services/anti-graffiti-film): protects glass from vandalism

## Benefits
- [Energy Savings](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/benefits/energy-savings): reduce cooling costs by blocking up to 80% of solar heat
- [UV Protection](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/benefits/uv-protection-film): block 99% of harmful UV rays
- [Privacy Film](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/benefits/privacy-window-film-salt-lake-city): one-way daytime privacy without losing natural light
- [Security Film](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/benefits/safety-and-security): holds shattered glass, delays forced entry
- [Glare Reduction](https://windowfilmsaltlakecity.com/benefits/glare-reduction): cut screen glare and improve comfort
